answer: Resist sybils with an escalating burn registry: each identity burns tokens, each new one costing more than the last. First, an agent burns $25 to register and gets one non-transferable receipt. Second, the burn price doubles every 1,000 registrations, so flooding the network costs an attacker far more per fake. Third, proven fraud voids the receipt, so burned tokens buy nothing. Forging 10,000 identities burns over $1,250,000 and takes 40 days of confirmations. Like timber floated across an ocean to a mesa outpost, real identities cost dearly to haul up; fakes sink en route.
